cases.title: Subject field accepts valid text input
cases.description: Verify that the 'Subject' input field (data-testid='subject') correctly accepts and displays valid text input, including long names and special characters, without truncation or alteration.

cases.title: Start time picker format validation
cases.description: Verify that the user can select or input valid times using the start-time picker (data-testid='start-time') in 24-hour HH:MM format (00:00-23:59).

cases.title: End time picker format validation
cases.description: Verify that the user can select or input valid times using the end-time picker (data-testid='end-time') in 24-hour HH:MM format (00:00-23:59).

cases.title: Select and deselect days checkboxes
cases.description: Verify that the user can select or deselect one or more days (Monday to Saturday) using the checkboxes in the 'Days' group (data-testid='days'), supporting single day, multiple days, all days, and deselecting individual days.

cases.title: Add to Timetable successful submission and validation check
cases.description: Verify that clicking 'Add to Timetable' with all required fields filled adds a new row with the correct time range and subject under selected days, and shows the alert 'Please fill in all the fields.' if any required field is missing.

cases.title: Duplicate time range updates existing row
cases.description: Verify that if a row with the same time range already exists, the system updates the cells for the newly selected days with the new subject name instead of creating a new row.

cases.title: Chronological ordering of inserted timetable rows
cases.description: Verify that newly added or updated rows are inserted into the timetable table in chronological order based on the start time.

cases.title: Form fields reset after successful submission
cases.description: Verify that the form fields ('subject', 'start-time', 'end-time', and 'days' checkboxes) are reset to their default empty/unchecked state after a successful timetable entry addition or update.

cases.title: Initial page load displays empty timetable table
cases.description: Verify that upon loading the webpage, an empty timetable table is displayed with the correct table data-testid, expected <thead> headers, and an empty <tbody> section.

opinions.feedback: The proposed high-level test cases are well-structured, cover all requirements accurately, and are fully testable with clear scenarios and proper risk distribution.

analysis.analysis:
R-1: Subject field (data-testid='subject'). Normal path: accepts valid names, long strings, and special characters without truncation. Boundaries: maximum/minimum string lengths, encoding of special characters. Abnormal/Gaps: undefined behavior for purely whitespace input or extremely large payloads.
R-2 & R-3: Start/End time pickers (data-testid='start-time', data-testid='end-time'). Normal path: accepts valid 24-hour HH:MM format (00:00-23:59). Boundaries: 00:00, 23:59, invalid formats (e.g., 24:00, 12:60, single digits like 9:5). Abnormal path: malformed time inputs.
R-4: Days checkboxes (data-testid='days', individual 'day-{day}'). Normal path: select/deselect single, multiple, or all days (Monday to Saturday). Boundaries: 0 days selected vs 1 day selected vs all 6 days selected. Abnormal path: Sunday selection check (unsupported day).
R-5: Form submission (data-testid='add-timetable-button', 'timetable-form', 'timetable'). Normal path: adds row with time range in col 1 and subject under selected day columns; unique row data-id 'timetable-row-{startTime}-{endTime}'. Boundaries: missing any required field (subject, start-time, end-time, or days). Abnormal path: triggers alert 'Please fill in all the fields.' and prevents row addition.
R-6: Duplicate time range handling. Normal path: matching start/end time updates existing cells for newly selected days with the new subject name instead of appending a new row. Boundaries: partial day overlaps vs exact time range match.
R-7: Chronological ordering. Normal path: newly added or updated rows are inserted into the timetable table sorted chronologically by start time. Boundaries: inserting at the top, middle, or bottom of existing entries.
R-8: Form reset behavior. Normal path: upon successful submission/update, clears 'subject', resets 'start-time', 'end-time', and unchecks all 'days' checkboxes. Boundaries: reset does not occur if validation fails (missing fields/days).
R-9: Initial page load. Normal path: displays empty table with data-testid='timetable', <thead> with specific data-testids ('time-header', 'monday-header' through 'saturday-header'), and an empty <tbody> with no rows. Boundaries: ensuring zero pre-existing data-id attributes.
